certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Hybrid Powertrains

learning_outcomes.text: Classify hybrid architectures and their degrees of hybridisation
Explain power-split, series and parallel hybrid operating modes
Analyse energy flow and the role of the engine, motor and battery
Describe energy management strategies and mode transitions
Explain regenerative braking and engine start-stop in hybrids
Evaluate hybrid efficiency benefits for different duty cycles

integrative_case: An OEM must choose a hybrid architecture for a city-biased compact car: the team compares mild, full and plug-in options, defines operating modes and an energy-management strategy, and justifies the expected fuel-economy benefit.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
